name: cortico-world-voice
description: Cortico World: let the bot speak on this computer (offline Windows SAPI), listen to audio files, and measure or shift the pitch of a recording. Optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.

zh.description: 让桌宠在本机出声（Windows 自带 SAPI，离线）；也能把工作区里的音频转成文字、量音高、给录音变调。可选接本地 GPT-SoVITS 音色。

en.description: Let the bot speak on this computer offline with the built-in SAPI voice; also transcribes audio files, measures pitch and shifts it. Optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.
